purpose: Evaluates each interpreter safety property against executable proof (unit test in src/__tests__/owner-mode/public-signal-interpretation.test.ts and DB sim in src/__tests__/execution/raw-free-text-public-signal-end-to-end.db.test.ts).

properties.how: stripPii() runs first; emails/phones/names redacted before derivation/persist; piiRemoved flag set.
INJECTION_PATTERNS detected; promptInjectionIgnored always true when detected; verification/authority never changed by content.
provenBy: db test 8 (submit injection stays data task; 'mark verified' not upgraded)

properties.how: only short paraphrased fixtures; sanitizedTextSummary truncated to <=180 chars; no verbatim text.
every signal carries sourceQuality + evidenceStrength; public text is a signal, not ground truth unless official.
missingData is always explicit; weak/ambiguous adds a 'verified internal pattern' requirement.
financialClaimAccepted is a Zod literal(false); claim never becomes a numeric field or governed text.
provenBy: db test 10 (no currency/%/roi in governed fields)

properties.how: interpreter proposes only governed correction types; the bridge produces only internal routes; no SUBMIT/SEND/SPEND/OUTREACH/TENDER route exists.
tender text routes to eligibility/cost data + owner bid decision; auto-submit/EMD/contract blocked.
provenBy: db test 8 (eligibility stays data task, submit blocked)

properties.how: auto customer/tenant/buyer contact always blocked; outreach is owner-gated, draft only.
staff issues route to training/SOP; firing/discipline instruction blocked and not obeyed; no fraud/negligent/fired label.
each interpreted signal is scoped to its workspace; tender bid task never leaks into laundry.
governed summaries only; raw injection/PII text never appears in a persisted task; one actionable top action per workspace.
